note: Technician-set stimulus labels, by stimulus id. Hand-edited or written by AdminTools; NOT generated. shared/stimuli/build.mjs reads `overrides` and it wins over both the label frozen in source-manifests.json and the one derived from the filename, so a label set through AdminTools survives a rebuild. `derived` records the label each override replaced, so clearing a display name puts the library's own label back without waiting for a rebuild; the build ignores it.
